dispositions.notes: The absolute unit-bearing cutoff was defective, although the sharp reproduction was at 1e-12 rather than the evaluator's proposed large-value example. The old cutoff produced an almost-zero relaxation and omitted the fractional flow. Positive residual traversal plus a graph-width-scaled ULP bound is invariant across the tested 1e-12, 1, and 1e15 scales. Reinstating the old cutoff makes the named gate fail.

The prior undocumented tie rule treated an unknown estimate as worse than every known estimate. Cost now breaks an equal-load tie only when both estimates are known; deterministic non-cost ordering decides otherwise and aggregate cost remains unavailable. Reinstating the old comparison makes the named gate fail.
